tagline: Bookmark any Odoo record, list view, menu, or report and open it instantly from a sidebar
problem: Odoo has no universal bookmark system. Users juggle browser tabs, stars, and copy-paste links to reopen the same records every day.
solution: Bookmarks adds a cross-model bookmark hub with folders, pins, colors, notes, tags, Ctrl+B hotkey, and a systray sidebar for instant navigation.
benefits: Bookmark any record on any model, including custom apps
Organize bookmarks into Sales, Invoices, CRM, and custom folders
Pin urgent items and add notes for context
Search bookmarks from the sidebar without leaving your screen
Actionable bookmark types for records, list views, menus, and reports

features.title: Universal record bookmarks
features.text: Star any form view record with one click or Ctrl+B.

features.title: Folder sidebar
features.text: Browser-style folders with drag-ready ordering and color tags.

features.title: Pin and favorite
features.text: Keep critical bookmarks on top across sessions.

features.title: Notes and tags
features.text: Add context like Urgent or VIP without leaving the record.

features.title: List view bookmarks
features.text: Save filtered list views such as Overdue Invoices for one-click reopen.

features.title: Smart button
features.text: See bookmark count on sale orders, partners, invoices, and leads.
